## Preparation-round-only copied-feat Ready — proposed successor completed

```text
SELECT_EXACT_PROPOSED_PREPARATION_ONLY_COPY_READY_AUTHORING_SUCCESSOR_WITH_IMPLEMENTATION_HOLDS
```

**The owner-selected policy is now reconciled across the proposed feat rules, Control15’s copy-Ready reference, affected examples, implementation requirements and handoff.** The older both-touched-round policy is explicitly superseded—not erased from history.

The package contains **30 exact JSON operations across eight artifacts, plus one complete handoff replacement**. All full before/after values, complete baselines and complete successor files are included.

**Nothing was applied to project files, GitHub, the index, registry or runtime flags.** The supplied applied baseline remains **525 reviewed / 323 pending / 249 standalone / 173 interfaces**, with **39 accepted-but-unapplied identities**.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}[Download the complete preparation-only Ready successor](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Part5_Copy_Ready_Preparation_Only_Successor_01.zip)

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="1"}[Read the complete review](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Part5_Copy_Ready_Preparation_Only_Successor_01/REVIEW.md) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="2"}[Read the full selected policy](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Part5_Copy_Ready_Preparation_Only_Successor_01/POLICY_SELECTION.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="3"}[Read the Codex handoff](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Part5_Copy_Ready_Preparation_Only_Successor_01/CODEX_HANDOFF.md)

## 1. The operative selection

The new identifier is **`COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-02`**. It supersedes the both-touched-round accounting in `COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01` **only for the seven FS08/SUP07 copied-feat profiles**.

**At preparation:** validate and atomically spend the actual Action, costs, permission/use, components and preparation-round feat-copy allowance. Spend the preparation-round Mirrorsage shared allowance only when that engine is **actually owned and applicable**. Record casting history and strain once, establish the Ready concentration burden, and process the single preparation counter window.

**At release:** validate the same paid hold, completed and perceived trigger, actual Reaction, maintained concentration, current target/source requirements and original deadlines. Consume the hold once and spend the real Reaction.

**Neither same-round nor later-round release checks, reserves or spends another feat-copy or Mirrorsage shared allowance.** It also creates no second RP, component, capture-use, strain, casting-history or counter transaction.

An independently spent release-round allowance remains attributed to its original use. The delayed release neither overwrites that record nor treats it as a reason to fail.

The restrictions that remain are equally important: no new Action, Reaction refresh, capture, concentration slot or extended deadline is granted. Countering, abandonment, replacement, concentration loss and expiry retain preparation expenditures. A failed release cannot revive a hold that actually ended.

## 2. Exact reconciliation scope

### Four proposed feat-rule files: 13 operations

| File | Affected fields |
|---|---|
| `shared_rules.json` | `/rules/7/wording` |
| `supplements.json` | The copy contract’s `rankAndPayment`, `lifecycle` and complete `readyAllowanceDecision` |
| `candidate.json` | Both operative mirrors for **Arcane Adaptation, Eldritch Echo and Mimicry** |
| `FEAT_EXACT_01_ACQUISITION_CONTRACTS.json` | The corresponding three complete operative-procedure mirrors |

This includes the **leading generic cap language**, not just the appended policy. “One copy release per round” now expressly limits **new paid commitments—direct casts or Ready preparations—not completion of an existing paid hold**.

The complete new policy is identical across **12 full operative mirrors**; the separate rank/payment reference accounts for the thirteenth field operation.

All 335 native feat source objects, unrelated procedures, worked examples, acquisition predicates and selection/runtime flags remain unchanged. The seven profile definitions, FS09 and the other supplement groups also remain unchanged.

### Control15: metadata and reference only

The Control baseline is the exact **1,389,475-byte reviewed successor13**. Its new reference successor changes four metadata/reference locations:

```text
/id
/status
/fullConferenceReviewPart5_02/copiedFeatReadyBoundary
/copyReadyOwnerSupersession20
```

The new record preserves the complete previous boundary and identifies its supersession.

**All 15 full Control spell objects, actual shared routing, 30 original scenarios and 30 complete current cases remain unchanged.** Ordinary Ready’s accepted release-time target selection is not revised. The completed Control15 and Mental Prison conference is not reopened.

### Examples, requirements and handoff

The full **P5-CP09 and P5-CP10** integration obligations now express preparation-only accounting. The other eight obligations remain exact.

The reconciled Ready gap matrix removes later-round allowance debiting as an implementation target. **Not debiting that allowance is now required behavior—not a missing feature to add.** The matrix continues to identify the actual unimplemented preparation, trigger, Reaction, source, target, concentration, deadline and persistence machinery.

The continuity record preserves the complete old copy decision as historical evidence while marking its current disposition superseded. The full replacement handoff directs Codex to the new policy without rewriting any earlier receipt.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="4"}[Complete JSON operations](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Part5_Copy_Ready_Preparation_Only_Successor_01/POINTER_OPERATIONS_FROM_PROPOSALS.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="5"}[Complete handoff before/after operation](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Part5_Copy_Ready_Preparation_Only_Successor_01/TEXT_OPERATIONS_FROM_PRIOR_HANDOFF.json)

## 3. Original examples and revised outcomes

The package preserves the complete original examples and supplies **42 new finite specification cases** with full initial states, event inputs, before/after states and outcomes.

| Situation | Selected outcome |
|---|---|
| **Same-round release** | Uses the paid hold and real Reaction; no second allowance debit. |
| **Next-round release before expiry** | Preparation-round spends remain. The new round’s allowances are neither checked nor spent. |
| **Another lawful copy already used the release-round allowance** | The delayed release remains eligible if its other requirements still pass. The other copy’s spend is not overwritten. |
| **Actually owned Mirrorsage allowance already spent that round** | That spend alone does not block the paid hold’s release. |
| **Delayed release happens first** | It leaves a genuinely free current-round allowance available for another otherwise lawful commitment. |
| **No lawful Action for the competing copy** | The competing copy cannot occur. The policy supplies no additional Action. |
| **Competing cast actually replaces concentration** | The old hold ends. Preparation-only accounting does not preserve it. |
| **Reaction unavailable, trigger incomplete/unperceived, or target/source invalid** | No release commitment or new debit. The hold can wait only while genuinely live. |
| **Ready or an earlier capture deadline expires** | Expiry wins; no release or refund. |
| **Countered preparation or abandonment** | Preparation expenditures remain spent. |
| **Payload prevented after release commitment** | The Reaction and preparation remain spent; no release-round allowance was created to refund. |
| **Repeated release callback** | No second payload or spend. |

### Action availability is not being assumed into existence

The “another copy before delayed release” cases explicitly require a **separately lawful pre-expiry Action/source opportunity**. They do not grant one.

The reverse-order example releases the old hold **before its deadline**, then uses a separately supplied later lawful Action in that numbered round. It does not carry a still-held Ready past the owner’s next regular START just to obtain that Action.

Earlier capture limits still apply. **The new policy does not make every Eldritch Echo record capable of surviving into another numbered round.**

### Historical expectations remain visible

`ORIGINAL_AND_REVISED_EXAMPLES.json` preserves:

**20 original Ready specification methods, the complete old and revised ten integration cases, six affected feat worked cases, seven full Ready-lifecycle histories and 13 source acceptance examples.**

Four historical test expectations are explicitly superseded: adding the later-round allowances; refusing release because the later class allowance is spent; refusing because the later feat allowance is spent; and expecting a later-round allowance expenditure after payload prevention.

Their complete original functions and reference model remain historical evidence. They are **not** current regression requirements.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="6"}[Complete case dispositions and traces](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Part5_Copy_Ready_Preparation_Only_Successor_01/CASE_DISPOSITIONS.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="7"}[Original and revised examples](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Part5_Copy_Ready_Preparation_Only_Successor_01/ORIGINAL_AND_REVISED_EXAMPLES.json)

## 4. Reconstruction paths are alternative—not cumulative

**From the exact prior corrected feat proposals:** use the **13 feat-rule operations** within the 30-operation proposal plan.

**From the four exact original, still-unapplied authoring files:** use the **26-operation alternative**—the 13 inherited feat operations followed by the 13 owner-policy operations.

Both paths reproduce the same complete four rule successors and reverse to their respective complete original bytes. **Do not apply both paths to the same files.**

The Control reference path begins at its reviewed successor13, not original Current12. Its earlier substantive reconstruction remains a separate prerequisite where needed; do not reapply the old nine Control corrections to an already-corrected successor.

:chatgpt-content-reference{index="8"}[Alternative operations from the original feat files](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Part5_Copy_Ready_Preparation_Only_Successor_01/ALTERNATIVE_RULE_OPERATIONS_FROM_ORIGINAL.json) · :chatgpt-content-reference{index="9"}[All exact artifact bindings](sandbox:/mnt/data/DD_Part5_Copy_Ready_Preparation_Only_Successor_01/ARTIFACT_BINDINGS.json)

### Principal successor bindings

| Artifact | Prior proposed bytes → successor bytes | Successor SHA256 |
|---|---:|---|
| `shared_rules.json` | 61,525 → **62,507** | `9b6e49dafb6ffd0113ed84e79907fbe98fc0f1dea42ad68024ae168adf103149` |
| `supplements.json` | 829,091 → **831,749** | `0f738dff14af9c69ae0259570bc3257ed222fd5d4f62b803d80838fb6372b0b8` |
| `candidate.json` | 1,398,294 → **1,404,690** | `6292c47a64a4866283b54e849d1e567715730e6e63ad55b1a5eca467f601e814` |
| `FEAT_EXACT_01_ACQUISITION_CONTRACTS.json` | 1,209,299 → **1,212,497** | `788fc5afd2d433962c5a03f18968abed4aad1ddbbe95570b7ca4b8271faf1a71` |
| `CONTROL15_READY_REFERENCE_SUCCESSOR14.json` | 1,389,475 → **1,391,036** | `81200770f94be0b0bde1c018529eb8fe289ec1caedf8691bfe558555dce0b62e` |

The binding file also includes all complete baseline hashes and the four document successors.

## 5. Verification and limits

**2,233 read-only source, structural, full-value reconstruction and preservation checks passed**, with zero failures. Both forward and inverse reconstruction recover complete bytes, including original JSON key order where selection fields are added or removed.

**42 isolated policy cases passed 160 assertions.** A second execution reproduced the complete specification report byte-identically.

These tests use supplied source-validity, action, trigger and geometry predicates. **No project modules or actual game engine were imported or exercised.** Fixture serialization tests are not production save/load validation.

The complete latest Supplement02 and its nested evidence are included unchanged. **Thirteen distinct historical ZIPs** were checked. The four latest proposed Python reference modules and the 16 accepted Companion05/Illusion13 artifact files remain unchanged.

Full copied-feat Ready is still unimplemented. Positive canonical Shaman Step, nonteleport Step, attack/save Boon, native concentration transitions, active next-healing consumption and downstream expiry choice/removal remain separate obligations. The five whole positive-case content/contest holds remain intact.

The other three owner choices stay settled and unchanged. The SNES-style/direct-exploration CRPG direction and continuing AI assistance are carried forward, while C#/Unity/shared-clock proposals remain proposals—not evidence of existing code or adoption of unstated timing, traversal or cooperative policies.

## Return archive

**Filename:** `DD_Part5_Copy_Ready_Preparation_Only_Successor_01.zip`  
**Bytes:** **39,831,317**  
**SHA256:**

```text
41d19bad1b9b2b33b423fd989ddedd919d6a8c9647ec43c43214ddff63ce24d8
```

The finished ZIP was reopened, passed CRC and safe-member checks, and all **59 manifest-bound files plus the root manifest** were verified.

**This completes the narrow owner-policy reconciliation. It does not authorize application or claim complete Ready implementation. Rank8Damage6 and Rank7IdentityCasting5 remain the next delivered conferences.**
